## Phase Definition of Done (MASTER_PROMPT §12)

- [ ] migrations committed and applied cleanly to a fresh DB (or N/A)
- [ ] RLS + pgTAP tests pass (or N/A)
- [ ] Zod schemas shared client/server
- [ ] every action calls `requirePermission` (or N/A)
- [ ] unit + integration tests pass
- [ ] Playwright E2E incl. axe pass; screenshots at 360 px and 1280 px attached
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build` clean
- [ ] audit log entries written (or N/A)
- [ ] admin-guide page(s) written in `docs/admin-guide/`
- [ ] `docs/plan/progress.md` updated
- [ ] no TODOs without an issue link
